session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Big Gap Down Then Sideways Trading Range Day' (ET+12 hrs, May 15/16; inset Back to Middle of Broad Trading Range weekly). Gap down into the wedge at 7416 with reasonable buys looking for bull trend resumption (Low 1 then Low 2), swing highs and lows through 7465-7475, consecutive wedges and a higher-low double bottom at 7437, a rally to the 7475 double top at high of day testing yesterday's low (failed bull trend resumption), breakout mode in a bear channel with another Low 2 at 7449, and a late wedge sell-off to 7412 into the close.
